ProgressTape.answer_ready.detail: Native finite store and Noise premises construct the actual four-operation answer at entropy cursors 3 and 4. Successive handler calls advance to 4 and 5 and produce distinct connection IDs. This checks one handler with advancing entropy, not full reaction-loop or native RNG refinement.
